subject: Billing handoff: designate invoice creator and primary delivery method for BrightVane
messages:

Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing handoff: designate invoice creator and primary delivery method for BrightVane

Hi Nikhil,

We're getting close to contract signature and AP asked me to confirm who will *issue* invoices and how we'll receive them. Two quick questions from our side:

1) Will Redwood be the invoice originator (you send PDFs/e-invoices), or should BrightVane pull invoices from a portal?
2) If Redwood sends invoices, can we get copies delivered to accounts@brightvane.com + a VAT/evidence bundle for our EU entity?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier. For context our go-live target is May 15.

Thanks,
Jane Dover
Finance Lead | BrightVane Inc.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing handoff: designate invoice creator and primary delivery method for BrightVane

Jane —

Thanks for flagging. Short answer: we support both flows. A few implementation details to help you pick:

Option A — Redwood-originated invoices (default)
- Redwood issues and emails PDF invoices to the billing contact you designate.
- We can include a VAT evidence bundle (PDFs/CSV) per invoice or on a monthly roll-up.
- Good when AP expects emailed invoices and needs a human-readable copy.

Option B — Portal-first (preferred for scale)
- BrightVane's AP can pull e-invoices from our portal (SFTP/webhook/push), with an optional email copy.
- Portal option reduces manual routing and supports machine-readable formats (XML/UBL).

To move forward I need: billing contact email(s), remit-to legal entity, and whether you require VAT evidence per-invoice or monthly.

I attached a sample invoice so you can confirm required fields.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks Nikhil — quick preference from AP: portal-first. We want an e-invoice push into our AP system (XML or UBL) and an email copy to accounts@brightvane.com for incoming routing.

For VAT evidence: our EU entity (BrightVane EU B.V.) needs a per-invoice VAT evidence PDF included. Monthly roll-up won't satisfy our auditors.

Can Redwood push to our SFTP, or do you provide webhook + signed SFTP? If you need a contact in our IT team I can loop them in.

Sam

Sam/Jane —

Great, portal-first with an email copy is straightforward. To make this operational and avoid back-and-forth, I've sketched a small billing matrix (attached) that maps:
- Invoice originator (Redwood)
- Delivery mechanism (SFTP push / webhook / portal)
- Email copy recipients (primary AP + billing contact)
- VAT evidence packaging (per-invoice PDF)
- Signatory (Redwood or BrightVane, depending on entity)

Action items I propose (dates are relative to contract signature):
1) BrightVane to confirm AP SFTP/webhook endpoint and sample XML schema (due 2028-04-18)
2) Redwood to provide SFTP push config + test file + sample invoice (we already shared one) (due 2028-04-20)
3) Confirm billing contact and remit-to legal entity for invoice lines (due 2028-04-18)

I'll attach the billing matrix and a CSV example for your AP team to load. If signatory delegation is needed (BrightVane wants to sign invoices) call that out and we'll adjust the remit language.

Marissa Cole

- VAT evidence: per-invoice PDF included with every transmission for BrightVane EU B.V.
- Signatory: Redwood will issue invoices; BrightVane to confirm if they require counter-signed PDFs.
